hypothesis: WSP209 lambda10 mathematically enforced near-zero factors; test whether λ0.2 recovers B0 learning and novel-pair transfer for fully trained rank4 controls vs direct-weight programming. No post-result hyperparameter tuning.

datasets.generator: Fabricated rank4 factors coordinate k=sin((site+shift)*(k+1)*.37+seed*.013)+0.5*cos((site+shift)*(k+2)*.19+seed*.007), shift=.7 for D or 0 for C. Double target is rank4 dot product. C/C and D/D alternate A source for each site pair.
datasets.pairs: Hub (1,j),j2..64 plus (j,j+1), even j2..62. Complete all unordered 1..16, smoke all 1..10.
datasets.split: WSP200 existing SHA256 salted whole-site-pair FIT,VALID,PUBLIC_DEV,RESERVED and FIT stage B0..B3. Never generate RESERVED label. PUBLIC_DEV once and only after all FIT models frozen. Never use VALID.
datasets.source: FABRICATED_WSP210_<seed>, synthetic-only source_digest f repeated 64; no original GFP numeric measurement.

variables.source: WSP200 same core solver with process-local scoped lambda, no edits to WSP200 or PR #1331

arms.direct: WSP200 contradiction mode rank4; 16 B0 sweeps then 2 later sweeps, same write gate
arms.refit: WSP200 full_refit warm cumulative rank4, coordinatewise exact normal equations, frozen 100 sweep cap and three 1e-6 stable relative reductions; fail if not converged
arms.adam: Conventional rank4 full-batch Adam, same factor init and FIT labels, same rank/lambda. beta1=.9 beta2=.999 eps=1e-8 lr=.03; 2500 max epochs/stage, minimum300 and 100-epoch relative objective plateau <=1e-6; no held feedback. If no plateau report comparator UNQUALIFIED.
arms.no_update: Rank4 WSP200 frozen after B0 at λ0.2 only
arms.zero_readout: Predicted standardized interaction 0 from B0 mean, no fitted factor
arms.privileged_oracle: True synthetic generator factors, exact target ceiling, NOT matched-information control

metrics: B0 witness MSE after B0-B3, stage writes/solves and objective, cold bytes and hash, held equal site-pair group RMSE, zero-readout RMSE, privileged oracle RMSE, CPU/wall. Keep complete per-world result.

decision.valid: 4/4 worlds have 4 nonempty FIT stages and PUBLIC_DEV, 3 lambdas, finite stable results, exact cold restore, refit converged and Adam plateau confirmed, no source leakage; Linux/Windows agree classification and metrics within 1e-8
decision.control_recovery: at least 3/4 worlds λ0.2 refit AND Adam each B0 MSE <=0.70 respective λ10 B3 MSE, and held RMSE <=0.90 zero-readout
decision.competitive_direct: at least 3/4 recovered worlds λ0.2 direct B0 MSE <=1.05 refit B0 and held RMSE <=1.05 refit
decision.memorization_only: at least 3/4 worlds λ0.2 refit B0 <=0.70 λ10 B0 but held >0.90 zero-readout
decision.persistent_failure: at least 3/4 worlds λ0.2 refit AND Adam B0 MSE >0.80 λ10, held >0.95 zero-readout
decision.constraints: Never alter thresholds, seeds, budget or cohorts after full primary inspection; source-free developer smoke may run only on seed21001 before primary, one frozen primary comparison per OS.

interpretation: Only source-free synthetic development; does not demonstrate general intelligence, Yggdrasil native learning, or independent published-world improvement.
